demo_caption: A team at work in raak. Real interface, made-up tasks.
demo_label: A board of two projects, where a team adds a task, starts one, changes a bug to a chore, adds a label and moves a card to the other project.
highlights.text_1: Matches show up in each project at the same time, so you never search one project after another.
highlights.text_2: One click moves the work along, right where you see it.
highlights.text_3: Tasks are stored locally for offline search and direct updates. Changes are synced as you get back online.
highlights.title_2: Every card shows its next step
pricing.text_1: Ideal if you are just getting started.
pricing.text_2: For those that have multiple projects in production.
showcase.from_cella: Of all code is from Cella
text_2: Raak is a fast issue tracker for small teams with several projects at once. Most issue trackers make you navigate between projects, boards, and issue pages. Raak keeps everything in a single page view.
title_1:
Every issue. All projects.
One page.
title_2: An issue tracker that eliminates navigation
